lines.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
My childhood was hard. I grew up in a communal flat.
I know the problems of ordinary people.
I've been working as mayor for four years now.
We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Thank you for your trust!
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
